Hot to Go! How to beat the heat at Daisy Chain Fields

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by

Instaread

It's going to be a scorcher! Here's what to take to make your festival experience as magical as possible

By
Charlotte Gunn
-
25 August 2026
Facebook
Twitter
WhatsApp
ReddIt

    It’s less than a week until Olivia Rodrigo‘s inaugural festival, Daisy Chain Fields takes up residence in Irvine’s Great Park. The festival has seemingly come together fairly quickly, with Rodrigo only announcing it two months ago. With a killer all-female lineup featuring Chappell Roan, Bikini Kill, Rachel Chinouriri, Katseye and special appearances from Stevie Nicks and Sarah McLachlan, tickets unsurprisingly sold out in just 30 minutes.

    The Forty-Five will be on site reporting on all the fun, but after a sweltering summer in Los Angeles and Orange County, we are a little concerned about how to keep cool in a shadeless park for 12 hours without missing any of the action.

    The key is to come prepared – and be sensible. The acts alternate throughout the day at different stages which should hopefully prevent fans camping out for long stretches at a singular ‘main stage’ barrier. The festival site is reportedly quite small, so if you do need to take time out, you’ll be able to make it back to the music in no time at all.

    Southern California is under extreme heat warning so wear sunscreen, stay hydrated and look after each other – even if it means not being front row for your favourite act. There will be hydration stations with free, cool, filtered water and cooling stations placed all around the venue. 

    Permitted items

    • Empty reusable water bottles and hydration packs, and plastic or aluminum water bottles
    • Blankets, Sheets, Towels
    • Personal misting fans with a bottle no larger than 1.5 L (must be empty upon entry)
    • Sunscreen in non-aerosol containers is allowed in the size of 3.4 ounces or less
    • Factory sealed Naloxone/Narcan kit
    • Hydration/Electrolyte packets in factory sealed single serving package(s)
    • Small clutch purses and fanny packs that are 6″ x 9″ or smaller do not need to be clear, but can have no more than one pocket.
    • All other bags larger than 6″ x 9″ must be smaller than 12″ x 6″ x 12″ and clear.
    • Hydration packs are allowed and do not need to be clear, but must be emptied of all liquid and with no more than two main compartments and one smaller compartment.

    Not Permitted

    • Umbrellas, parasols
    • Outside food or beverage (including alcohol) of any kind
    • Aerosol containers, including sunscreen and personal beauty products

    With all this in mind, here is a shopping guide for Daisy Chain Fields, to help make your festival experience as magical as Liv intended. See you in the fields!

    Charlotte Gunn
